items.title: CVE-2024-10441: Synology DiskStation Manager remote code execution in system plugin daemon (Update: added to CISA KEV)
items.summary: Update: added to CISA KEV. Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM) and BeeStation OS (BSM) have a flaw in the system plugin daemon, caused by improper encoding or escaping of output, that lets an attacker run arbitrary code. The attacker can reach it remotely over the network without logging in, and the bug is listed as exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2026-90817: Vanderbilt University REDCap remote code execution in survey routing (Update: added to CISA KEV)
items.summary: Update: added to CISA KEV. REDCap, from Vanderbilt University, has a flaw in its survey routing and data import handling that lets an attacker run their own code on the server by sending crafted web requests, remotely and without logging in, as long as they know a valid public survey hash. This bug is listed by CISA as exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2026-40217: LiteLLM remote code execution via guardrails test endpoint (Update: added to CISA KEV)
items.summary: Update: added to CISA KEV. LiteLLM from BerriAI has a flaw that lets an attacker run arbitrary code on the server by abusing bytecode rewriting at the /guardrails/test_custom_code endpoint. It can be reached remotely over the network with only a low-privilege login, and it is listed by CISA as exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2026-114952: MySQL authentication bypass in client programs (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. A flaw in the client programs component of Oracle's MySQL Server and MySQL Cluster lets an attacker read, change, create, or delete critical data that these products can access. It can be reached remotely over the network without logging in, and no action from a user is needed.

items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. The Windows Win32 Kernel Subsystem, a core component of Microsoft Windows, contains a flaw that lets a user with local access gain higher privileges on the affected system. An attacker who already has some authorized access to the machine could exploit this to take greater control than they are permitted.

items.title: CVE-2026-90436: Apache Axis remote class instantiation in SOAP fault parsing (Update: added to CISA KEV)
items.summary: Update: added to CISA KEV. Apache Axis 1.x, an end-of-life SOAP engine for Java, is affected. An attacker can remotely instantiate arbitrary classes, which can lead to code execution on the server, by sending a crafted SOAP fault, and this works without logging in, since the fault is parsed before any service authentication handlers run.

items.title: CVE-2026-133247
items.summary: modified eCommerce Shopsoftware through 3.3.0 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability in admin/support.php that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject script via the module parameter. Attackers can trick a logged-in administrator into opening a crafted link to run script in the admin panel, reading CSRF tokens and changing shop settings.

items.title: CVE-2026-130759
items.summary: Fleet from 4.71.0 before 4.88.2 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the SAML SSO callback that looks up sessions using unvalidated client-supplied identifiers. Users able to run live queries or enroll secret holders can plant attacker-controlled identity provider metadata in the session store, then present a self-signed SAML response to log in as a global admin.

items.summary: Outstatic is a static site CMS for Markdown and MDX content stored in GitHub repositories. Prior to 2.2.1, the authenticated GitHub REST proxy accepts an unvalidated endpoint value, constructs an upstream URL by string concatenation, and attaches the current dashboard user's GitHub OAuth token without ensuring the destination remains the exact GitHub API origin. An authenticated dashboard user can cause the server to send that user's token to a non-GitHub host, potentially exposing private repositories and other resources allowed by the token's scopes. The issue does not let an unauthenticated…

items.title: CVE-2026-130754
items.summary: All versions of LaraDashboard contain an authentication bypass in SocialAuthService::findOrCreateUser(), which links a social login to an existing account by email without checking that the OAuth provider verified that email. Unauthenticated attackers using an OAuth/OIDC provider that asserts a victim's email can log in as any user, including Superadmin, and keep persistent access through a linked social_accounts entry.

items.title: CVE-2026-128666
items.summary: A Reflected Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in PHPGurukul News Portal Project V4.1. The $currenturl variable in news-details.php is constructed using unencoded REQUEST_URI and HTTP_HOST server variables and echoed directly into the href attributes of social share links. An unauthenticated remote attacker can exploit this by crafting a URL containing HTML metacharacters to break out of the href attribute and execute arbitrary HTML or JavaScript in the context of the victim's browser.

items.title: CVE-2026-115560: PHP remote code execution in session serializer
items.summary: PHP has a flaw where session upload progress data, when enabled, can be read back with a mismatched session serializer, letting an attacker inject objects into the application. A remote attacker who can submit a multipart upload, without logging in, could use this to run code if the application contains a suitable gadget chain, or to corrupt sessions or cause a denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-126714: PHP remote code execution in session file handling
items.summary: PHP's default file-based session handler can leave a session file with a mix of new and old data if a write is interrupted, so an attacker who can influence session data may inject objects and, if the application contains a suitable gadget chain, run code on the server. The attacker can reach this remotely without logging in, though the attack depends on interrupting a write at the right moment.

items.title: CVE-2026-129289: PHP remote code execution via unread request bodies
items.summary: PHP (PHP-FPM) can mishandle an unread HTTP request body when an application opens php://input without reading it fully. In setups where the web server reuses backend connections, which is not the default in nginx or Apache, a remote attacker with no login can send one crafted multipart request to forge a backend request and potentially run attacker-controlled PHP code.

items.title: CVE-2026-129496: PHP remote code execution in timezone cache
items.summary: A use-after-free bug in the timezone cache of PHP (from the PHP Group), in non-thread-safe builds where a startup warning is written to a file-based error log, lets an attacker crash PHP-FPM, Apache mod_php or CGI workers. Arbitrary code execution may also be possible. The attacker can reach it remotely, without logging in, by sending a crafted request.

items.title: 2026-022: Critical vulnerabilities in Nginx
items.summary: On 18 November 2026, F5 published an advisory addressing five vulnerabilities in NGINX that allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute code with the privileges of the NGINX worker process. While researchers managed to successfully demonstrate the use of CVE-2026-123007, no exploitation in the wild has been reported yet. It is recommended to swiftly update NGINX as soon as possible, prioritising internet facing appliances.

items.title: CVE-2026-130789
items.summary: SemanticMediaWiki from 7.3.0 before 7.4.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the smwtask API check-query task that allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass object-level authorization by relying on the wiki-wide edit right. Attackers can supply arbitrary subject titles, including protected pages, to run synchronous Semantic MediaWiki queries with caller-controlled conditions, limit, offset, and querymode parameters.

items.title: CVE-2026-130765
items.summary: Obot before 0.27.0 contains an open redirect vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass same-site validation of the rd parameter by inserting a tab character. Attackers can craft sign-in or sign-out links on the Obot domain that browsers resolve to external hosts, redirecting victims to phishing pages.

items.title: CVE-2026-130760
items.summary: Fleet before 4.86.2 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to exhaust server memory via unbounded BER recursion in PKCS#7 parsing. Attackers can send deeply nested indefinite-length structures to Apple MDM check-in, enrollment, SCEP, or OTA endpoints to crash the entire Fleet instance.

items.title: CVE-2026-128662
items.summary: PHPGurukul Employee Leaves Management System V2.1 contains an information disclosure vulnerability because database backup files are stored within the publicly accessible web root. An unauthenticated remote attacker can download the SQL backup files and retrieve sensitive database contents, including employee personally identifiable information and password hashes.

The application does not require verification of account ownership through an email token, OTP, or another authentication mechanism before updating the password, potentially resulting in account takeover.

items.title: CVE-2026-77295
items.summary: MyMangaDB is a self-hosted manga collection manager with automatic metadata, MyAnimeList import, Docker support, and collection statistics. Prior to 2.7.2, the unauthenticated /api/v1/database/export handler in backend/app/api/v1/endpoints/database.py returns a ZIP containing the live SQLite database and the cover-image library. This issue is fixed in version 2.7.2.

items.title: CVE-2026-76430
items.summary: A vulnerability in the Ultimate Packer for eXecutables (UPX) unpacker of ClamAV could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause a DoS condition on an affected device. This vulnerability is due to improper length checks, when unpacking the UPX files, which may result in an out-of-bounds read of heap memory. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by submitting a crafted UPX for decode. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to cause the ClamAV decode process to terminate, resulting in a DoS condition on the affected software.

A successful exploit could allow the attacker to cause the ClamAV scanning process to terminate, resulting in a DoS condition on the affected software.

items.title: CVE-2026-76416
items.summary: A vulnerability in the InstallShield file parser of ClamAV could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause a DoS condition on an affected device. This vulnerability is due to incomplete error checking when the InstallShield File Parser is performing a scan. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by sending a crafted InstallShield file to be scanned. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to cause the ClamAV scanning process to terminate due to an infinite loop, resulting in a DoS condition on the affected software.

items.title: CVE-2026-76415

An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by sending a PE file to be unpacked. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to cause the ClamAV scanning process to terminate, resulting in a DoS condition on the affected software.

items.title: CVE-2026-76414

An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by sending a crafted CHM file for scanning. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to cause the ClamAV decode process to terminate due to an infinite loop, resulting in a DoS condition on the affected software.

items.title: CVE-2026-130750
items.summary: Network-AI from 5.11.0 before 5.17.2 contains a CORS misconfiguration in McpStreamableServer that reflects localhost Origins into Access-Control-Allow-Origin regardless of bind interface. items.title: CVE-2026-129986 Dokploy: OS Command Injection via filePath in mount.deleteFileMount → HOST RCE
items.summary: Dokploy is a free, self-hostable Platform as a Service PaaS. Prior to 0.31.1, mount.deleteFileMount passes a path containing the user-controlled filePath to the local removeFileOrDirectory helper, which interpolates it unquoted into rm -rf, while the remote branch is quoted. An authenticated member with file-mount create and delete permissions can execute arbitrary commands in the host context immediately when deleting a local file mount, without requiring a running container. This issue is fixed in version 0.31.1...

items.title: CVE-2026-59961
items.summary: mini-snmpd is a minimal SNMP agent implementation. items.title: CVE-2026-132776
items.summary: GPAC MP4Box before 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT loader that allows attackers to crash the process by supplying crafted XMT files. Attackers can assign a second node to an SFNode command field so xmt_node_end() frees a forward-referenced child still cached in peeked_nodes, triggering a crash during DEF lookup in xmt_find_node().

items.title: CVE-2026-132764
items.summary: GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT loader that leaves ROUTE commands of a discarded node queued after being freed by gf_sg_command_del(). Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene file imported with MP4Box so xmt_resolve_routes() writes to freed memory, corrupting the heap and crashing the process.

items.title: CVE-2026-110337
items.summary: The Strava datasource plugin's resource handler POST /strava-api forwards a client-supplied endpoint string, and its query parameters, to the Strava API (https://www.strava.com/api/v3/) without validation. items.summary: A use-after-free flaw in PHP (from the PHP Group) lets an attacker corrupt memory, crash PHP-FPM or mod_php workers, and possibly run their own code. It can be reached remotely without logging in, but only on servers with specific per-path or per-directory configuration, where a fatal error during request shutdown leaves stale data that a later request on the same worker then uses.

items.summary: Update: now rated critical. The Linux kernel's Ceph filesystem client can read past the end of a stack buffer when handling a metadata server map from a monitor. An attacker who can send a crafted map claiming more ranks than the buffer holds could cause a memory-safety fault in the kernel.

A malicious or compromised metadata server can send a crafted snapshot message that makes the kernel read memory past the end of the received message buffer. items.title: CVE-2026-99310: Linux kernel use-after-free in NFSD open owner tracking (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. A flaw in the Linux kernel's NFS server (nfsd) can cause a use-after-free memory error when it handles a client identification request with mismatched credentials at the same time as another request is freeing client state. An attacker can reach it remotely over the network without logging in, which could let them take control of the system or crash it.

items.title: CVE-2017-7577: Arbitrary file read via directory traversal in HTTP server (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. XiongMai uc-httpd has a directory traversal flaw that lets an attacker read arbitrary files on the system. An attacker can exploit it remotely, without logging in, by sending a crafted "GET ../" HTTP request.

items.title: CVE-2026-130968: Google Chrome sandbox escape for code execution in Views (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. A use-after-free flaw in the Views component of Google Chrome on Windows lets an attacker run arbitrary code outside the browser's sandbox. The attacker can reach it remotely without logging in, by tricking a user into installing or interacting with a crafted Chrome extension.

items.title: CVE-2026-130926: Google Chrome sandbox escape via confused deputy in Sync (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. A flaw in the Sync feature of Google Chrome lets an attacker who has already compromised the browser's renderer process potentially run arbitrary code outside the sandbox. It can be reached remotely, without logging in or any user interaction, by sending crafted network traffic.

items.title: CVE-2026-131043: Google Chrome sandbox escape to code execution in HID (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. A use-after-free flaw in the HID component of Google Chrome lets an attacker run arbitrary code outside the browser's sandbox. The attack works remotely without logging in, but it relies on social engineering: the victim must be tricked into installing a crafted Chrome extension.

items.title: CVE-2026-111218: Netgate pfSense CE OS command injection in traffic shaper limiters (Update: now rated critical)

A remote attacker who has logged in with Traffic Shaper Limiters privileges can edit a limiter's number value and then delete that limiter, which runs arbitrary shell commands as root.

items.summary: Cozy Cloud cozy-stack 1.6.62 before 1.6.69 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the shared-drive move handler that allows authenticated users to access other instances' files. Attackers owning a shared drive can name another instance's domain and any directory ID as the move source to copy and delete the victim's file tree.

items.summary: modified eCommerce Shopsoftware through 3.3.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated administrators to inject scripts via the unsanitized products_model field. items.summary: parse5 7.0.0 before 8.1.1 contains an uncaught exception vulnerability in Preprocessor#_processSurrogate that allows remote attackers to crash applications by supplying two consecutive low surrogates. Attackers can submit input such as U+DC00 U+DC00, which decodes to out-of-range code point 0x110000 and throws a RangeError from parse, parseFragment, or streaming parsers, crashing Node.js processes.

items.title: CVE-2026-133244
items.summary: parse5-html-rewriting-stream 7.0.0 before 8.1.1 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability in RewritingStream#emitText, which skips escaping based on a stale lastStartTagName. Attackers can place entity-encoded markup after a closed script or style element to bypass RewritingStream-based filters and execute script in users' browsers.

items.title: CVE-2026-133242
items.summary: diaspora* before 0.10.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated users to inject script by crafting og:video:secure_url values. Attackers can post links to pages whose allowlisted-prefix video URL contains a quote and onload handler, executing script in readers' sessions when they click the video preview.

items.title: CVE-2026-133240
items.summary: OpnForm before 2.8.2 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in PublicWebhookUrl::isPublicIp that fails to reject CGNAT, NAT64 and 6to4 address ranges. Authenticated users can configure webhook, form import or PDF image URLs resolving to these ranges to make the server send HTTPS requests to internal hosts.

items.title: CVE-2026-133238
items.summary: SABnzbd through 5.1.3 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the Sorter that allows attackers to write files outside the Complete folder via crafted propername, episodename or job name (%dn) values. Attackers can supply a malicious NZB with '...' sequences that collapse to '..' after single-pass replacement, moving downloaded files into arbitrary directories writable by SABnzbd.

items.title: CVE-2026-133236
items.summary: Modoboa before 2.13.0 contains a CRLF injection vulnerability that allows Resellers or users with domain add or change permission to inject rspamd DKIM selector map entries by supplying an unvalidated dkim_key_selector through the relay domain API. Attackers can embed a carriage return in the selector to override another tenant's domain selector, causing rspamd to sign its outgoing mail with a nonexistent selector and fail DKIM verification.

items.title: CVE-2026-133235
items.summary: Tandoor Recipes before 2.7.4 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows space admins to reach internal hosts because Nextcloud.get_client builds WebDAV clients from Storage.url without calling safe_request. Attackers can create a NEXTCLOUD storage via POST /api/storage/ pointing at internal hosts, import a file, then call GET /api/get_recipe_file// to read internal service or cloud metadata responses.

items.title: CVE-2026-133233
items.summary: Quasar before 2.35.3 contains a DOM clobbering vulnerability that allows attackers to break native wrapper detection by injecting HTML elements named Capacitor, cordova, or StatusBar. Attackers can place markup such as a div with id Capacitor into server-rendered or pre-rendered HTML so app.use(Quasar) throws and the application never mounts, or openURL() and AddressbarColor.set() throw.

items.title: CVE-2025-71472
items.summary: littlefs 2.8.0 through 2.11.3 contains a divide-by-zero vulnerability in lfs_mount_() that allows attackers to crash processes mounting crafted filesystem images when block_count is 0. Attackers can supply an image lacking a superblock entry or recording block_count 0, causing lfs->seed % lfs->block_count to trigger SIGFPE and denial of service.

The captureRemote mechanism previously stored only a boolean flag indicating whether the link was internal, and the authorization check in captureSGExisting relied solely on that flag. items.title: CVE-2026-133174
items.summary: HotGo 2.18.6 through 2.19.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows authenticated backend users to read other administrators' private letters because the messageIds helper omits the receiver filter. Low-privilege users can call GET /admin/notice/pullMessages, which is exempt from role permission checks via exceptAuth, to retrieve titles, contents and senders of private letters.

items.title: CVE-2026-133171
items.summary: Tiptap @tiptap/core 3.7.0 before 3.30.5 contains a regular expression denial of service vulnerability in parseAttributes and parseShortcodeAttributes that allows attackers to exhaust CPU through quadratic backtracking. Attackers can supply Markdown with long crafted attribute strings parsed by createBlockMarkdownSpec, createAtomBlockMarkdownSpec or createInlineMarkdownSpec to stall browser pages or server processes.

items.title: CVE-2026-133170
items.summary: Tiptap @tiptap/core 2.0.0-alpha.0 before 3.30.4 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows attackers to inject DOM attributes via a __proto__ key passed to mergeAttributes(). items.title: CVE-2026-99406
items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: xfs: fix lost errno returned from xfarray_foliosort LOLLM noticed that we stop the sort early but don't actually pass along the error code, which could enable repair code to continue running with an unsorted array. items.title: CVE-2026-99405
items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: xfs: abort dirtree repair if the live update hook dies LOLLM notices that if the live update hook for the directory tree repair code hits an error, it will set dl->aborted and stops working. If the repair code ever sees that condition, it ought to bail out immediately instead of continuing with obsolete data.

items.title: CVE-2026-99404
items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: xfs: check fork type against dabtree block magic number LOLLM complains that we fail to flag dabtree blocks that should never be associated with the file fork -- data forks can't point to xattr leaves, and attr forks can't point to dirent blocks. Add the missing checks.

items.title: CVE-2026-99403
items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: xfs: mark overfull dabtree node blocks as corrupt LOLLM observes that we need to range-check the dabtree node record count before using it to index an array. Fix that.

items.title: CVE-2026-99402
items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: netfilter: nft_payload: restrict checksum offsets to known values We need to prevent userspace from corrupting e.g. tcp->doff, because many locations in conntrack and conntrack helpers rely on nf_conntrack_in() having validated the packet headers. nft_payload allows to alter headers later which invalidates this assumption. The 'Fixes' commit restricts writes to safe fields, but there is another side channel: the checksum location. Restrict this too. Reported via sashiko/gemini.

items.title: CVE-2026-133074
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. Insufficient authorization checks in the quiz overrides web service allow an authenticated user with teacher privileges to modify user and group overrides for quizzes they do not have permission to manage. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability to improperly alter exam access, deadlines, or testing conditions across unauthorized courses.

items.title: CVE-2026-133073
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle's single view grade report web service. A missing authorization check allows authenticated students to view the names of all grade items in a course, including those configured to be hidden. This vulnerability leads to unauthorized information disclosure.

items.title: CVE-2026-133068
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. An improper authorization check when displaying individual glossary entries allows an authenticated user to view approved glossary items from courses they do not have permission to access. This vulnerability leads to unauthorized information disclosure of restricted educational materials.

items.title: CVE-2026-133067
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. Due to missing ownership checks in badge alignments, an authenticated user with badge management privileges can view and modify alignments associated with badges they do not own. This vulnerability can lead to unauthorized data disclosure and tampering with badge configurations.

items.title: CVE-2026-133060
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle's Blackboard question import format. Insufficient validation of file paths during the question import process allows an authenticated user with permissions to import questions into a question bank to read arbitrary files accessible to the web server process. An attacker could leverage this vulnerability to view sensitive files, resulting in unauthorized information disclosure.

items.title: CVE-2026-133059
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. The grade feedback web service does not properly verify group and course enrolment permissions. An authenticated user with non-editing teacher privileges can exploit this vulnerability to access grade feedback and user profile details across groups or courses they are not authorized to view, leading to unauthorized information disclosure.

items.title: CVE-2026-133114
items.summary: Caddy – WooCommerce Side Cart & Free Shipping Bar plugin for WordPress 3.0.0 before 3.2.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the saved-items/add REST endpoint that exposes non-public product data. Authenticated attackers with Subscriber-level access can enumerate product_id values to read names, prices, images and stock status of private, draft, hidden and password-protected products.

items.title: CVE-2026-62259
items.summary: HTSlib is a library for reading and writing bioinformatics file formats. Prior to 1.21.2, 1.22.3, 1.23.2, and 1.24, the experimental CRAM v4 functions cram_xpack_decode_char and cram_xrle_decode_char do not validate that attacker-controlled decode sizes remain within their expanded input arrays. Crafted CRAM data can therefore make either decoder read beyond the supplied input buffer, potentially disclosing process-state information or crashing the process through invalid memory access. This issue is fixed in versions 1.21.2, 1.22.3, 1.23.2, and 1.24.

items.title: GHSA-PJ7P-238H-76PV djangocms-moderation: Moderation comments disclosed to non-participant staff via the admin changelist
items.summary: Summary The Django admin views for moderation comments CollectionCommentAdmin and RequestCommentAdmin render the full comment body but scope access only by an attacker-controlled id in the URL and Django's model-level viewcomment permission. items.summary: rails-html-sanitizer is responsible for sanitizing HTML fragments in Rails applications. If a permissive call admits a script element or event-handler attribute, output expected to be sanitized under a stricter policy can retain it and cause cr…

items.title: GHSA-VG83-HCP4-5QCC DOMShell: domshell_eval classified as read-tier can execute side-effecting JavaScript without --allow-write
items.summary: Summary The domshelleval MCP tool and the eval command inside domshellexecute was classified as read-tier, allowing it to run without the --allow-write server flag.
